nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name, set to DELOREAN in the constructor.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set to DLN in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances, written by approve and transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, allowance keys and balance debits.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and crediting msg.sender.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) and credits safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
Spends from allowance, moves balances between from and to without verifying allowance sufficiency.
SafeMath addition with overflow require check.
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require check.
SafeMath multiplication with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath division with non-zero divisor require check.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply in totalSupply().
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] without requiring allowance >= tokens, allowing allowance underflow to revert or unintended state.
tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf used as mapping key.
tokenOwner parameter of allowance used as mapping key.
spender parameter of allowance used as mapping key.
spender parameter of approve used as allowance key.
tokens parameter of approve written into allowed mapping.
to parameter of transfer credited via safeAdd.
tokens parameter of transfer debited via safeSub.
from parameter of transferFrom whose balance is debited.
to parameter of transferFrom credited via safeAdd.
tokens parameter of transferFrom moved between accounts.
First operand a of safeAdd.
Second operand b of safeAdd.
First operand a of safeSub.
Second operand b of safeSub.
First operand a of safeMul.
Second operand b of safeMul.
Numerator a of safeDiv.
Denominator b of safeDiv.

edges.reason: Constructor credits the whole _totalSupply to msg.sender.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply value.
_totalSupply is read by the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
balances[address(0)] is read by the unchecked subtraction without SafeMath.
totalSupply() returns the result of the unchecked arithmetic operation.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve keys the allowance on the caller msg.sender.
approve writes tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] based on the untrusted caller identity.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance accounting.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without validating sufficient allowance.
transferFrom updates balances of from and to.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom performs the allowance spend without any allowance >= tokens check.
msg.sender spends another account's allowance through the unchecked path.
tokenOwner parameter feeds the balances lookup in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter feeds the allowed lookup in allowance.
spender parameter feeds the allowed lookup in allowance.
spender parameter is used as allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is stored into the allowed mapping in approve.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter determines the debited amount in transfer.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the moved amount in transferFrom.
Operand a flows into safeAdd.
Operand b flows into safeAdd.
Operand a flows into safeSub.
Operand b flows into safeSub.
Operand a flows into safeMul.
Operand b flows into safeMul.
Numerator a flows into safeDiv.
Denominator b flows into safeDiv.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is a local parameter of balanceOf; its dataflow is fully captured by the function node.
tokenOwner is a local parameter of allowance; its dataflow is fully captured by the function node.
spender is a local parameter of allowance; its dataflow is fully captured by the function node.
spender is a local parameter of approve used only for the allowance key.
tokens is a local parameter of approve written directly into the allowed mapping.
to is a local parameter of transfer used only for the credit target.
tokens is a local parameter of transfer used only for the debited amount.
from is a local parameter of transferFrom used only for the debit target.
to is a local parameter of transferFrom used only for the credit target.
tokens is a local parameter of transferFrom used only for the moved amount.
